user_query: I'm planning a hiking trip and would like to explore the surrounding areas. Can you recommend some nearby places to visit? Additionally, provide me with a heightmap image of the region to get an idea of the terrain. Moreover, I would like to download an English tile map for offline use.

TaskList.description: Research and recommend nearby places to visit around the hiking area.
Generate a heightmap image for the specified hiking region.
Download an English tile map for offline use.
